android.desc:
The Clicks app lets you customize your Clicks Keyboard settings and preferences.

Keyboard backlight - Control the brightness and dim timeout of the keyboard backlight. 

Caps lock - Control the behaviour of the shift key. When turned on, pressing the shift key once makes the next charater a capital letter. Double clicking the shift key enables shift lock. When disabled, you must press and hold shift to get a captial letter.

Alt lock - Control the behaviour of the '123' key. When turned on, pressing the '123' key once makes the next typed character a number of symbol. Double clicking the shift key enables number lock - (great for typing phone numbers of long number strings!). When disabled, you must press and hold '123' to get numbers and symbols.

Key customization - Configure the function of keys like the Clicks key, alt and Gemini button

Cursor mode - Enable cursor mode to use WASD and IJKL as directional cursor keys

Update your keyboard firmware over the air to optimize the typing experience.

* Certain features and functionality are dependent on your Clicks model.
